text: dsh-peak-cost-mode 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 DeepSeek 峰谷省流插件：它按北京时间工作日高峰时段向系统提示加入超精简输出要求，并可由用户在低谷手动开启。插件包装流式模型调用，记录输入、缓存命中和输出 token，按内置或配置价格估算省下的 token 与人民币；峰谷状态、切换时间和收益可通过标题栏徽章、提示框、输入区读数及报告面板查看。它还提供峰谷统计、主动省流开关和清空台账接口，数据保存在本机 DSH 配置目录，适合希望减少高峰输出并观察估算费用的 DSH Web 用户。

dsh-peak-cost-mode is a DSH Web plugin that adds concise output instructions during DeepSeek peak hours and offers a manual saving mode. It records streamed token usage, estimates savings using configured prices, and displays status and reports. Configuration and statistics are stored locally.
想让 DSH 在 DeepSeek 工作日高峰时自动用更精简的回答。
我想看峰时省下多少输出 token 和大约多少费用。
低谷时也能手动打开精简回复模式吗？
想在 DSH 页面上看到当前是高峰还是低谷。
Show me an estimate of tokens and money saved during peak hours.
Automatically make DSH replies more concise during DeepSeek peak pricing.
Let me turn on a concise response mode manually during off-peak hours.
Display peak pricing status and savings in the DSH web interface.
dsh-peak-cost-mode 的功能「峰时自动精简」：按北京时间工作日配置时段切换状态，并向系统提示加入精简输出要求；每 10 秒检查峰谷变化。
dsh-peak-cost-mode 的功能「省流收益估算」：包装流式模型调用并收集 token 用量，按模型价格和压缩率计算估算节省量，生成当前波次、今日和累计统计。
dsh-peak-cost-mode 的功能「Web 状态与报告」：页面显示峰谷徽章、切换提醒和收益报告；用户可通过面板开启或停止主动省流并清空统计。
dsh-peak-cost-mode 使用前须知：节省 token 和人民币金额按配置的压缩率与价格估算，并非实际账单；配置文件可调整这些假设。见 src/index.mjs:445-510。

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · dsh-peak-cost-mode：DeepSeek peak-pricing cost guard for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) (DSH): during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Mon–Fri Beijing time 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, price ×2; weekends are always valley) the agent automatically switches to ultra-compressed **caveman-style output** to cut output tokens, and a header badge + toast keep you posted on every peak/valley transition.

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · Features：- **Automatic peak detection** — Beijing time (UTC+8, no DST) is checked every 30 s against the DeepSeek V4 peak-pricing schedule:
  | Window (Beijing) | Tier | Price |
  |---|---|---|
  | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 | Peak | ×2 |
  | Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 | Valley | ×1 |
  | Mon–Fri 14:00–18:00 | Peak | ×2 |
  | Mon–Fri 18:00–next 09:00 | Valley | ×1 |
  | **Sat & Sun (all day)** | **Valley (weekend)** | **×1** |
- **Peak-hour cost saving** — while in a peak window, a "Peak Cost Mode" prompt section is injected, instructing the model to reply in ultra-compressed caveman style (drop filler/pleasantries/hedging, keep all technical content verbatim: code, commands, API names, file paths, exact error strings, numbers; safety warnings and irreversible-action confirmations are never compressed).
- **Transition reminders** — toasts on every tier switch:
  - valley → peak: 「梁文锋来了，少说话多做事。」(Liang Wenfeng is here — talk less, do more.)
  - peak → valley: 「梁文谷来了，一切正常。」(back to normal)
- **Persistent status badge** — right side of the session header (left of the session-log button): red `高峰 ×2 · 省流中` during peak, green `🟢 低谷 · 主动省流中` while voluntary saving, green `低谷

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-peak-cost-mode

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · or from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:moon09300731/dsh-peak-cost-mode
```

Then restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser page.

  "saveRatio": 0.6,
  "baseCacheHitRate": 0.5,
  "multiplier": 2,

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · Configuration：- `saveRatio` — assumed output-compression ratio of the cave-man mode (default 0.6; bounds 0–0.9).
- `baseCacheHitRate` — assumed input cache-hit rate for the “without plugin” counterfactual input invoice when no valley-time measurement exists (default 0.5).
- `peakWindows` — array of Beijing-hour peak windows, each `{start, end}` (default `[{9,12},{14,18}]`).
- `weekendValley` — `true` (default) means Sat/Sun are always valley/off-peak; set `false` to restore the old weekend-peak behavior.
- `multiplier` — peak multiplier used for the RMB conversion (default 2).
- `prices` — per-model valley prices in ¥ per million tokens; exact model keys override the built-in flash/pro defaults. **Prices go stale — verify against the official DeepSeek pricing page; displayed savings are estimates, not an invoice.**

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · How it works：- Host (`src/index.mjs`): a 10 s timer computes the Beijing wall-clock time and drives a three-state machine (`peak` / `voluntary` / `none`). Any saving state registers a `systemPrompt` section (`peak-cost-mode`, order 60) that makes model steps reply in compressed caveman style; leaving the state disposes the section. It subscribes to the `llm/stream` waterfall, wrapping each call to capture `usage` (input/cacheRead/output tokens) + model id on clean completion, and books it into the open saving wave (tagged `source: peak` or `source: voluntary`). Exposes `GET /api/peak-cost/state`, `GET /api/peak-cost/stats`, `POST /api/peak-cost/voluntary?active=true|false` (persistent voluntary switch) and `POST /api/peak-cost/reset`.
- Client (`client.js`): polls `/api/peak-cost/state` every 10 s (mirroring a snapshot to `localStorage` key `dsh.peakCost.v1`) and renders the badge, toasts, the composer readout and the report panel (with the「我要省钱！」/「停止省流」buttons in the bottom-right corner).

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · How it works：> Note: the prompt section is registered in the host scope, so during any saving mode it applies to **all sessions** of the deployment (that is the cost-saving point). If you want per-session compression only, use the dynamic-plugin variant instead.

dsh-peak-cost-mode README · Development：```sh
npm test                       # node --check src/index.mjs && node --check client.js && unit tests
node scripts/verify.mjs        # independent recompute of /api/peak-cost/stats (all-PASS = correct accounting)
```
